info.title: Omneity Public API
info.description: Reviewed public HTTP contract. Generated from maintained definitions; checked against API source. Pass-through object responses are intentionally open. Prices are deployment-dependent; see the pricing reference.

get.description: Model visibility does not guarantee entitlement or healthy capacity.

post.description: OpenAI-compatible text and tool calls. Multimodal input/output depends on the model. Use Tarjamli's exact single-user translation template for tarjamli-v3.

example.line: I keep my heart above the rain

example.text:
I wait in rain
I take the train

example.task: Research Morocco solar energy with sources

post.description: Use this collection's search key. A general model API key does not replace it. CORS requires an explicitly configured origin.

encoding_format.description: Use float for portable TEI support. Other encodings depend on the deployment.

top.description: Positive k returns top-k predictions; non-positive values request all predictions.

max_candidates.description: Use 1 to 3 candidates for a portable request. Confirm the current account limits.

model.description: Discover supported public aliases with GET /v1/models.

language.description: Language hint. Confirm the supported codes for the selected public model.

audio.description: Audio or video, at most 128 MiB.

response_format.description: wav is the portable choice. pcm16 support depends on the selected deployment.

Error.description: Errors can contain FastAPI detail or an error object. Inspect the HTTP status first.

Object.description: Pass-through response. Additional service fields can be present.

/v1/speech/transcribe/stream.authentication: Bearer header, x-api-key header, or sawalni-key.BASE64URL_KEY subprotocol from a browser. Do not put keys in query strings.
/v1/speech/transcribe/stream.client: Send start JSON, binary PCM frames, then {type: stop}. Confirm selected model supports streaming; HTTP-only aliases can fail.
